---
name: research-summary
description: Synthesize selected literature with traceable citations, field provenance, conflicts, and a clear evidence-scope statement.
---

# Research summary

- Use only the user-selected records and extracted material for source-grounded claims.
- Start with a scope statement: metadata-only, abstract-based, full-text, or mixed/incomplete.
- Attach claims to citation identifiers and page/paragraph/section locators; do not invent citations.
- Distinguish consensus from disagreement and retain unresolved bibliographic conflicts.
- State search date, providers, query limits and any provider failures or missing full text.
- Create a new Markdown or DOCX report through the document tools. Keep the NotebookLM handoff user-mediated.
